description: (Na)₂NiHgF₆ crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NiHgF₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NiHgF₆ framework, Ni is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NiF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent HgF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ni-F bond lengths are 1.99 Å. Hg is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form HgF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NiF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Hg-F bond lengths are 2.28 Å. F is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ni and one Hg atom.
